name: Lich (Eladrin Wizard)
tactics: This lich uses entropic pulse and thunderclap as often as it can. Once bloodied, it spends an action point to use second wind.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Necrotic Aura
traits.details: any living creature that enters or starts its turn in the aura takes 5 necrotic damage.

traits.name: Indestructible
traits.details: When a lich is reduced to 0 hit points, its body and possessions crumble into dust, but it is not destroyed. It reappears (along with its possessions) in 1d10 days within 1 square of its phylactery, unless the phylactery is also found and destroyed.

auras.name: Necrotic Aura
auras.details: any living creature that enters or starts its turn in the aura takes 5 necrotic damage.

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target is stunned until the end of the lich’s next turn

effect.description: The lich spends a healing surge and heals 90 hit points. The lich gains a +2 bonus to all defenses until the start of its next turn.
